# Puny Characters — Shade — CC0

Primary author listing: https://merchant-shade.itch.io/16x16-puny-characters
Primary OpenGameArt listing: https://opengameart.org/content/puny-characters

Both identify these character assets as CC0 and permit commercial use. The project voluntarily credits Shade; attribution does not imply endorsement.

The three unchanged PNG files were downloaded from the `ult0/robo-game` mirror at commit `ff919255acbe5ce74f2127a18fd637f95aeb1e52`. Each binary's SHA-256 matches the original Git LFS object ID recorded by the independent `series-ai/jam-ready-assets` mirror at commit `ab1b21fe61bc3adeb759c286e770033563f18a97`. Paths, URLs, byte lengths and hashes are in `animation_assets.json`.

`MIRROR_LICENSE.txt` is the series-ai mirror maintainer's license summary, not an original notice from the artist. `CC0-1.0.txt` is the full CC0 legal text from SPDX's license-list-data repository, retained unchanged. The cloud environment could read the primary listing but downloaded the PNGs from the pinned mirror; this notice does not claim receipt of the artist's original ZIP.

Source images are unchanged. Godot AtlasTextures slice their frames, and runtime transforms/actual-equipment overlays present them. Original weapon-bearing frames are restricted to the clearly labelled reference gallery. The live character profile uses equipment-free body frames; recoverable weapons and armour read actual inventory instances.
